# PIC16F (PIC14E)

This page lists the PIC16F parts that use the PIC14E core and that
`epic-cc` can target, for anyone picking a chip in this family.

| Part | Flash words | RAM bytes | EEPROM bytes | Status | Lifecycle | Datasheet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PIC16F13145 | 8192 | 1024 | none | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/MCU08/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/PIC16F13145-Family-Microcontroller-Data-Sheet-DS40002519.pdf) |
| PIC16F1933 | 4096 | 256 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41575C.pdf) |
| PIC16F1934 | 4096 | 256 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41364E.pdf) |
| PIC16F1936 | 8192 | 512 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41364E.pdf) |
| PIC16F1937 | 8192 | 512 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41364E.pdf) |
| PIC16F1938 | 16384 | 1024 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/40001574D.pdf) |
| PIC16F1939 | 16384 | 1024 | 256 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/MCU08/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/PIC16F-LF-1938-39-Micorcontroller-Data-Sheet-40001574E.pdf) |

## Notes

- RAM bytes counts what the compiler can allocate, not the datasheet total.
- Parts with `experimental` status compile, but are not yet checked by the
  project's own test matrix.
- The full list of parts is in the [device matrix](../index.md).

## Status

See [What's in 1.0](https://apojomovsky.github.io/epic-docs/status/) for this family's support level.
